evidence_references: Source PR #629 fixes cached Pi receiver readiness after same-device reconnect, with fresh validation before composing settings and immediately before persistence. Identity, replacement, ambiguity and calibration protections remain enforced. A read-only retry preserves unsaved scan-plan edits. Bounded receiver setup status uses the existing authenticated check-in summary without serials, paths, location or credentials.

Release identity PR #630 head 44301ae9f4cf1ede2570b2e291a0b9ded9d45502 merged at a496bfcb6b7fa9041aec74e4c4a3f4289cd1d721. Complete trees match. Source descends from published Build 306 source 0266071b7e17238a26e168f2af6245321bbbfb9b. Both required source checks passed: https://github.com/gdowkpc/apollo/actions/runs/38998916541

31 focused identity, reconnect/save, retry UI and diagnostic tests passed on Windows and on the physical ARM64 builder. Existing fix regressions include service recovery/regression, delayed default binding, missing/multiple/replacement devices, disconnect before persistence and diagnostic privacy.

Two independent physical ARM64 builds are byte-identical: 19879245 bytes, SHA256 47699f99572bb9cc18c8de7caddc912f784a97cd256622957ee2f8d3f94e8208. The release retains the published Build 306 native runtime inputs and unchanged KA9Q pin.

The exact final ZIP passed the required ARM64 clean/legacy convergence and rollback, RSP1B module/profile closure, readable RTL native inventory and native/embedded executable sample-stream health gates: https://github.com/gdowkpc/apollo/actions/runs/38999433232

Production-signed updater 1.0.85 remains unchanged. Its Ed25519 authority, archive digest and controller capsule binding are verified. No new updater, trust policy, receiver-specific build or private driver patch is introduced.

This application candidate enables canonical complete-installer qualification. Actual owned-bench installation, authenticated reporting and reboot evidence are required by the separately signed complete-installer gate before the public download card changes. Other receiver and known-transmission accuracy qualification remain separate. See docs/apollo-build307-candidate.md.
